acceptanceCriteria: tools/cem-citation-baseline over a migrated cem/1.0 map measures it at the migration rewrite (a T' target, e.g. --targets or the listed cemMigrationCommits) and reports the same citation rows as the pre-migration 0.2 read except the spec member, with a test over one migrated fixture map.

A rerun over all committed maps on main after beamfall/corvint#841 merges is retained under docs/build-log/evidence with 0 rows read as excluded-artifact-mismatch, and the DCW-V0-049 class-split baseline row is updated.
body: Source: V1-1277 builder report (PR beamfall/corvint#841, docs/build-log/2026-10-12-v1-1277-cem-migration.md). Observed 2026-10-12: with #839's tools/cem-citation-baseline (stable --artifacts read at the bind commit), the 614 migrated maps read as invalid excluded-artifact-mismatch, because a migrated map verifies only at its migration rewrite, not at the bind commit (CEM-V1-104). 860f59ea (native 1.0) reads valid. The V1-1277 lane's --targets change was reverted to avoid colliding with #839; evidence of the mismatch is retained as docs/build-log/evidence/v1-1277/citation-post-1281tool*. Expected: the baseline tool measures migrated maps at T' so post-migration citation-class baselines (V1-1281 criterion 3, V1-1266 first 30 maps) are producible.
title: cem-citation-baseline: measure migrated cem/1.0 maps at their migration rewrite (T'), not the bind commit
